summary: Gorax showcases the top team compositions for the Season 8 endgame boss Mekkatorque (Rasp of Gears, Phase 1). He compares damage outputs between Inspiration 5 and Inspiration 0 to help both competitive spenders and free-to-play players. High-performing setups include Thunderbolt reaching nearly 6 billion damage and Poison/Toxin hitting over 6.1 billion with Child of Chaos. He also highlights an accessible budget Ice team led by Aethereal that deals over 1.2 billion damage even at Inspiration 0.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Provides team survivability with extra healing at Inspiration 2 and enables the Poison composition to break 6 billion damage.

heroes.name: Perkunte
heroes.note: Serves as the cornerstone of the Thunderbolt team, which achieved nearly 6 billion damage at high inspiration and 1.5 billion at Inspiration 0.

heroes.name: Aethereal
heroes.note: Core damage dealer in a highly accessible Cold team that deals roughly 1.24 billion damage regardless of whether she is at Inspiration 0 or high inspiration.

heroes.name: Saverio
heroes.note: Substantially outdamages Daphne when built as the main DPS at high inspiration, pushing Shadow team output past 2.3 billion.

heroes.name: Irmoush
heroes.note: Keeps the Thunderbolt team alive even at Inspiration 0 as long as he has sufficient Skill Haste for a 15-second rotation.

heroes.name: Lothair
heroes.note: Benefits heavily from Enlightenment and Attack stacking, performing best with his second talent selection.

heroes.name: Beldelle
heroes.note: Demands the highest Attack stat on the squad to receive all priority buffs and Master Genie scaling.

heroes.name: Nastjenka
heroes.note: Must be built with higher Attack than Guinavivre to properly direct team and pet buffs in AoE scenarios.

teams.note: Top-performing Lightning squad capable of 5.97B damage at I5 and nearly 1.5B damage at I0.
Deals over 6.1B damage at high investment and over 1.2B at I0 with 15-second or 30-second skill rotations.
F2P-friendly team dealing 1.24B damage at Inspiration 0 by stacking diverse debuffs and sharing Resistance.
Reaches 2.88B to 3B damage; requires strict 15-second Skill Haste tuning on Diantha, Lincos, and Anneliesis.
Hits 2.3B damage at high inspiration and over 880M at I0; switch main DPS priority to Seyir if Saverio lacks artifacts or inspiration.
Achieves 2.1B to 2.8B at I5 and 626M at I0; relies on Ernesto shielding and buffing Beldelle.

tips: Ensure your designated primary damage dealer (such as Beldelle, Talethia, or Nastjenka) has the absolute highest Attack stat on the team so pet and artifact buffs target them.
Tune Skill Haste on critical supports and enablers (like Diantha, Lincos, and Irmoush) to hit consistent 15-second skill rotation timings.
Do not feel forced to chase high inspiration on all heroes: the Aethereal debuff team produces roughly the same 1.24B damage at I0 as it does at max inspiration.
Shadow and certain DoT setups are projected to deal even higher damage when transitioning into Phase 2 of Mekkatorque.
